Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your position.

Our data shows a different picture on some points:
Our demand forecast for this part has risen 11.9% (fc:350011@2026-09).

Please find our proposal below.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have verified your increased volume forecast and incorporated it into our pricing. We can accept your terms and await your order.

Our Angebot stands at a price of €361.82 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a Preisgleitklausel on CU-NOTATION. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

We accept your proposed CU-NOTATION index clause and the 90-day payment terms. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? Our standard terms apply to everything the quote does not state; see attached.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

decisions.tactician: o6 gives the lowest C of all options (€2,251,155). It is also worth more to the supplier than its own sheet (+5.0 %), so acceptance is likely. It meets the supplier's strong copper need, and the wide deadband keeps the clause cost low. E0 and o2-o4 are worth less to the supplier and price below its estimated cost. That invites counters and a relationship charge under the stabilise goal, and their C is still higher. The volume argument supports the deal; citing our order history would clash with a price above it.
